title: GitHub Actions 派生自动化应在同一运行内完成，而不是依赖 GITHUB_TOKEN bot commit 串联 push workflow
summary: 当一个 workflow 使用仓库 GITHUB_TOKEN 写回 commit 时，该 commit 的普通 push 事件不会继续触发新的 workflow run。需要顺序完成的收集、分诊、提案、派生索引和报告应在同一 workflow run 内显式执行，或使用明确的 workflow_dispatch/repository_dispatch/更高权限 token 方案；不得把 bot commit 当作隐式事件总线。
principles: A producer workflow owns dependent deterministic transformations needed for a complete transaction.
Bot commits are persistence outputs, not assumed workflow triggers.
Separate workflows may provide human-push/manual repair entry points without being required for pipeline continuity.
Avoid introducing a broad PAT solely to recover implicit push chaining when same-run orchestration is sufficient.
Pipeline reports and derived indexes are committed atomically with their source transformation when practical.

provenance.evidence_level: observed baseline bot commit produced no downstream push workflow run
